title: Minisforum MS-A2, 3 x M.2 2280 (PCIe 4.0 x4) plus one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot (x4 electrical)
notes: The three M.2 slots hang off the CPU's GPP bridges 0000:00:01.2, 01.3 and 01.4 (PCIe 4.0 x4 each). SMBIOS describes only the first, by its reference designator J3502; the other two are identified by their root ports. Which of 01.3 and 01.4 is physically M.2 2 versus M.2 3 is assumed from bridge order and has not been checked with a drive swap. The x16 slot is bridge 0000:00:02.1 (PCIe 5.0 x4), which SMBIOS calls PCIE4; a drive on an adapter card in it lands there. Bridge 02.2 (PCIE3) is the Wi-Fi E-key slot and 03.1/03.2 are the onboard NICs; none of them is a drive bay.

bays.note: a drive on an adapter in the x16 slot
